answer: Continuous physical custody proof. Each agent identity carries a saffron-marked hardware token bound to one uninterrupted power-and-motion trace; the registry accepts an identity only while that trace remains continuous, and any gap voids it. The token is the anchor tying identity to a single physical unit. Attackers must buy, house, and keep powered one device per identity with no gaps—an operator cannot fake a hollow custody record, since a forged trace fails the continuity check. Cost: one device plus continuous power per identity.
